answer: Sybil resistance works when each identity must post a bond that is slashed if it is caught cheating, so a hundred fake agents cost a hundred bonds and no profit survives the attempt. Reputation must be earned through scarce, audited work rather than claimed: like water carving a karst channel only where it truly flows, standing accrues only to agents with a verifiable history of honest tasks. A tundra of idle, unproven identities earns nothing, while an oasis of trust forms around agents whose record peers can check.
